variants.headline: Shipbuilding for the colony route
variants.body: The home world has built a larger ship or an additional ship for the colony route. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Home world builds for the colonial crossing
variants.body: Shipbuilding by the home world has provided a larger vessel or another vessel for the colony route. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Route gains a shipbuilding development
variants.body: A larger ship or one more ship has been built for the colony route. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
